title: Paris Hilton To Star With Landman & The White Lotus Actors in Amazon Comedy - NewsBreak
text:
By Anubhav Chaudhry ,
1 hours ago Paris Hilton is reportedly heading to the big screen for a new holiday comedy backed by Amazon MGM Studios. The project pairs the media personality with a group of rising television actors for a travel-themed story. Early details about the cast and creative team have now emerged.
Paris Hilton joins cast of Clashing Through the Snow According to Deadline , Paris Hilton has joined the cast of Clashing Through the Snow, a holiday comedy produced by Wonderland Sound and Vision and Amazon MGM Studios. She appears alongside Christopher Briney, Michelle Randolph, and Lukas Gage. The film draws inspiration from “Planes, Trains and Automobiles for today’s generation,” presenting a modern holiday travel comedy for contemporary audiences.
Filmmaker Carlson Young directs the film for Wonderland Sound and Vision partners McG and Mary Viola. Lena Roklin of Luber Roklin Entertainment also produces the project. Daniel Mackey and Rebecca Ewing wrote the screenplay as a follow-up to their Netflix film Love Hard, which became hugely popular on the streaming platform.
Paris Hilton plays a stylized version of her pop culture persona in the film. Hilton serves as the CEO of 11:11 Media and works as a musician, actress, and philanthropist. She continues her work across entertainment, business, and media projects.
Earlier, filmmakers J.J. Duncan and Bruce Robertson released the feature documentary Infinite Icon: A Visual Memoir. The documentary chronicles Hilton’s musical journey, and it marks the latest installment in a personal trilogy that documents different stages of her life and career.
The documentary trilogy began with the 2020 documentary This Is Paris and continued with her bestselling memoir Paris: The Memoir. Industry Entertainment’s Kyle Luker serves as an executive producer on Clashing Through the Snow alongside writer-director Ari Sandel. The production brings together Amazon MGM Studios and Wonderland Sound and Vision for the holiday comedy project.
